pages.text: $(bold)How to obtain$():$(li)Mine $(bold)Gheloth Ore$() on the $(bold)roof of the Nether$() (Y 110-127) without Silk Touch - 1-3 pieces, boosted by Fortune$(li)At the Casting Table, combine the $(bold)Iron$() material with $(bold)100 mB$() of $(bold)Gheloth Blood$() to craft the Remains material - the blood comes from smelting remains (15 mB each) or from the ore$(br2)Tier: $(bold)T4$().

$(bold)Innate traits$():$(li)$(l:traits/trait_cosmic_order_voice)Voice of the Cosmic Order$(): on hit, inflicts Slowness and Blindness, with durations that grow stronger as the trait levels up$(br2)Gheloth Remains itself is also one of the $(l:relics/relic_gheloth_remains)Ancient Relics$() - a single source that feeds both rituals and materials.
